description: Write per-query adapter functions mapping the dsqgen -LOG parameters to the DataFrame parameter keys, wire them into the gate builder (benchbox/core/equivalence/builders/tpcds.py) at the gate's scale, and measure. A flat name map is insufficient: Q39's SQL uses [MONTH] and [MONTH]+1 while -LOG records only MONTH.01 and the DataFrame expects months: [1, 2]. Verified drift between the gate's SQL and the DataFrame defaults: Q39 SQL year 1998 months 4-5 vs default 2001 [1,2]; Q49 SQL 2000/month 12 vs default 2001; Q41 SQL BETWEEN 742 AND 742+40 vs default [738,129,830,540]. Q44 and Q93 are SQL-empty at SF 0.01-0.1 and diverge only at SF=1 (verified from probe data). Hypothesis (unproven): with parameters rendered at the data's scale they become non-empty and match at SF=0.1. Q41 is the negative control because its implementation hard-codes colors and reads manufact_start with a literal fallback; do not prototype on it. Falsified if Q39, Q44, Q49 or Q93 still diverge under identical bindings, or an adapter cannot be written without ambiguity.
